## Summary
- Scaffold FireWeave control-points harness for `apps/api` (`@fireweaveai/server-sdk@2.3.0`), wire `initFwHarness` at boot, and bind cohort identity on login.
- Install Cursor/Claude standing loops, build gates, and agent instructions so feature work stays promote-not-wrap.
- Plumb `FW_API_URL` / `FW_PROJECT_API_KEY` / `PUBLIC_FW_PROJECT_API_KEY` through compose, deploy script, and GitHub Actions (secrets set in repo settings; not committed).

## Test plan
- [ ] Local API boots with `NODE_ENV=development` and no FW credentials (dev provider)
- [ ] Confirm GitHub secrets `FW_API_URL`, `FW_PROJECT_API_KEY`, `PUBLIC_FW_PROJECT_API_KEY` exist
- [ ] Deploy to EC2 and confirm prod container receives FW env vars and boots (prod provider)
- [ ] Spot-check `await initFwHarness()` is first await in `apps/api/src/main.ts`
- [ ] After merge, reload Cursor so copied skills/rules apply


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Initialise FireWeave rollout-ready for the API
